scenario.name: r-cd-model-tool
scenario.description: continue_delegate typed tool form forwards the fixed available override openai/gpt-5.6-luna to the delegate child; any other observed runtime identity is a failure candidate.
scenario.notes: This row deliberately requests the available OpenAI model openai/gpt-5.6-luna. It remains blocked on karmaterminal/openclaw#1103 until authoritative child runtime metadata reports that exact identity instead of an inherited, fallback, or otherwise different model.
scenario.registryNotes: Runnable k6 scenario exercises typed continue_delegate with the fixed Luna override. An authoritative child identity that differs from Luna is a FAIL verdict; absent, ambiguous, or execution-unbound effective-model evidence produces no row verdict. Only authoritative exact Luna identity can proceed toward PASS.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: report the current model identity from runtime context and the nonce only. The requested model is intentionally omitted from the child task to prevent echo-based false PASS. Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the parent request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate for this model row

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-observed
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-correlated delegate child session/run is observed on the subscribed session stream or session history

expectedReceipts.name: child-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Observed child provider/model byte from authoritative gateway child-session metadata or spawn record; child prose is auxiliary only

expectedReceipts.name: return-payload
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return includes the row nonce and observed model/provider summary

expectedReceipts.name: trace-or-session-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Trace id, span tree, or session-event correlation tying dispatch to child and return

expectedReceipts.name: requested-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Committed request byte showing continue_delegate model=<provider/model>

review.notes: A PASS-candidate exists only when the fixed requested byte openai/gpt-5.6-luna matches authoritative gateway child-session metadata or spawn-record model bytes. The child task omits the requested model and its self-report is auxiliary only. If authoritative effective identity is bound to this execution and differs from Luna, emit a FAIL verdict. If effective identity is absent, ambiguous, or cannot be authoritatively bound to this execution, fail closed with no row verdict.

liveRunSafety.notes: Explicit fixed openai/gpt-5.6-luna override row. Prevent echo-based false PASS by omitting the requested model from the child task. An authoritative bound fallback, inheritance, or any other model identity produces a FAIL verdict; unavailable, ambiguous, or unbound effective-model evidence produces no row verdict.
